answer: In PoA, reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, requiring sustained honest service rather than brief bursts of favorable reports. A freshly spawned Sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because no trusted peers reciprocate its attestations; temporal decay and reciprocity-weighted transitivity keep it isolated. Thus, whether named ember, fable, or oasis, it cannot pass consensus without durable, corroborated behavior.
